Description: PLV functional connectivity for passing task: Observe self passing to opponent
ComputationDetails: Calculated from preprocessed EEG; Frequency bands: theta (4-7Hz), alpha (8-12Hz), beta (13-29Hz), gamma (30-48Hz); Time windows: 10 consecutive 100ms windows (1-100ms to 901-1000ms); 40 ROIs; PLV file order matches preprocessing subject order
Note: PLV condition reflects independent observation/imagery of passing direction (not related to raw EEG markers C12/C14/C16/C18)
